meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 为代码变更生成极简提交消息，遵循 Conventional Commits 格式。主题行用祈使句、尽量≤50字符；正文只在解释非显而易见的“为什么”等必要时出现，最终以代码块输出。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”“commit message”“generate commit”“/commit”等，或调用 /caveman-commit 时触发；暂存变更时也会自动触发。

say.text: /commit 用 caveman-commit 生成提交信息
say.note: 直接触发技能，输出代码块

say.text: 把暂存区的改动整理成 commit message
say.note: 暂存已就绪时也会自动触发

howto.what_en: Generates ultra-compressed commit messages in Conventional Commits format. Subject uses imperative mood, ≤50 chars; body only when non-obvious "why" etc. needed. Output as a code block.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invoke /caveman-commit; also auto-triggers when staging changes.

say_en.note: Generates a minimal Conventional Commits message.
Invokes the skill and outputs a code block.

say_en.text: Turn the staged changes into a commit message
